name: SL0 dictionary E_a = Xi(z+ia)
statement: With A_a=8 int Phi cosh(2au)cos(2zu), B_a=8 int Phi sinh(2au)sin(2zu), Xi=8 int Phi cos(2 lambda u): E_a := A_a - i B_a = Xi(z+ia). Verified to 1e-30 on the trig core, 1e-15 in full. Canonical shift is a; imp-3382 channel numerics use shift a/2.

name: T3(a) iff E_a Hermite-Biehler iff zero-free strip
statement: Via the Hermite-Biehler reproducing kernel, twin-ladder T3(a) holds iff E_a is in the Hermite-Biehler class iff zeta has no zero with Re s > 1/2 + a. T3(a) for all a>0 is RH. T3 is a restatement of the strip statement, not a mechanism.

name: sigma(a)=sup|Xi(z-ia)/Xi(z+ia)| takes values in {1, infinity}
statement: By Hadamard/Blaschke structure sigma(a) is 1 (no zeros in the strip) or infinite. The measured norm ||R|| about 1.33 is not a constant to push below 1; the gap is norm versus pole-freeness. Related obstruction row G2 (coupling norm).

name: SL2 flow-blindness no-go
statement: Any hypothesis stable under Phi -> e^{-eps u^2} Phi cannot imply all zeros real: since Lambda >= 0, the backward-flowed function has a non-real zero for every eps>0. A proof must use arithmetic input. Obstruction rows F1, F2; HEAT control.

name: Theorem NS-RIGID (native-span rigidity)
statement: Every Hermitian-form input expressible on E_V = span{e^{-nu t} 1_{t>0}} is either flow-stable (positive definite on a finite node set S, persists under Gaussian damping to eps=100) or equals RH (all-S family = Lagarias-Pick). No intermediate. Covers rows P3, P5, P18.

name: Lacunary/Blaschke node-family loophole inside the native span
statement: Geometric (Blaschke) node lattices fail the identity-theorem step, so their PSD family is not equivalent to RH; reaching RH needs sum 1/s = infinity (Muntz-complete), where trace-class structure is unavailable. Route 13: lacunary {4^k} Pick >= 3.6346e-4 certified, no zero information. Row P18.

name: Theorem RES-T: fixed-support Weil positivity vs verified height
statement: W_T >= 0 on tests supported in [-T,T] follows from verified height X=3e12 for T < T_X = 3.882 (half-width; 2a = 7.764 in the support-width convention). Above T_X it needs pointwise control of a Dirichlet polynomial up to heights about exp(8 e^T). Row P19.

name: Dirichlet-coefficient/mollifier inputs as the non-circular class
statement: Levinson-Conrey (>= 41.7% on-line) and Selberg-type inputs are flow-critical, not RH-equivalent, and locate zeros beyond soft methods, but deliver proportions (mean values), not every zero. No in-repo twin-ladder object hosts them. Rows P26, P27, Q9 give the measured limits.

name: Stat-mech creative sweep: 8 routes reduce to Weil positivity
statement: Reflection positivity, arithmetic freeze-flow, signed interferometer, Peierls, Widom, Kramers-Wannier, log-gas RG, Connes-Consani scaling site: each worked to a verdict; all reduce to Weil positivity. Symmetry-forced properties of sigma=1/2 are RH-blind; no soft deformation confines zeros.

name: Pure log-gas is anti-confining (Earnshaw)
statement: For the 2D log-gas of zeros without arithmetic phases, transverse curvature is F_C''(0) = -4S < 0: electrostatics alone pushes zeros off the line. Confinement comes only from the phase cancellation cos(t log n), i.e. Weil positivity.

name: FE-compatible signed arm designs reconstruct Davenport-Heilbronn
statement: Functional-equation compatibility pins arm signs to root numbers; every design with at least 2 arms is a DH-type combination, and Voronin universality gives >> T off-line zeros. DH control.

name: sigma=1/2 as fluctuation-susceptibility peak
statement: Parseval in 2 sigma halves the Hagedorn abscissa 1 -> 1/2, so sigma=1/2 is the susceptibility peak of the primon gas. The property is forced by symmetry and is RH-blind (equivalent to Bohr-Landau/Littlewood zero-density statements).

name: Connes-Consani scaling site: exact archimedean vs p=2 cancellation at u=ln 2
statement: Positivity across u = ln 2 is an exact cancellation of the archimedean term against the p=2 term; residual/P_2 = 7.5e-5 on the Slepian gap. CC theorem is near-sharp (7-18% past (ln 2)/2). The second adelic direction block-diagonalises into L(s,chi) Weil forms (a family statement).

name: Detector uncertainty principle 2a_det ~ 0.9 ln(gamma/2pi)
statement: A Weil-type test detects an off-line zero at height gamma only with support 2a about 0.9 ln(gamma/2pi), i.e. primes up to (T/2pi)^0.9, independent of adelic direction.

name: Gaussian-damped primon Gram detector (Class II)
statement: A Gaussian-damped Gram form on primon-gas states detects off-line zeros, but only up to height about 1/sqrt(t) for damping t; finite-N reflection positivity is false with lambda_min ~ -p_N^{1/2-nu}; infinite-N reflection positivity equals Weil positivity.

name: Arithmetic freeze-flow: confinement iff interlacing
statement: Multiplicative flow is inert (translation); the additive force is the Riemann-Siegel partial sum and is tangential. Zero confinement under the flow is equivalent to interlacing (Hermite-Kakeya-Obreschkoff), which is RH.

name: Pole-free Weil positivity = Toeplitz T_a[sigma_2] >= 0
statement: On L^2(-a,a), 2a < ln 3: W(h) = (1/2pi) int w_1 |hhat|^2 with w_1 = 2 theta' - sqrt2 ln2 cos(t ln2). Pole-free positivity is exactly T_a[sigma_2] >= 0, sigma_2 = (t^2+1/4)^2 w_1 (hhat = (t^2+1/4) ghat). sigma_1 = (t^2+1/4) w_1 is only the half-pole-free form.

name: ARB-LEGE: one-prime pole-free Weil positivity for all 2a <= ln 3
statement: Arb (256-bit) certifies W(h) >= 8.2045e-4 ||h||^2 on pole-free h in L^2(-a,a) for every 2a <= ln 3; corollary lambda_1(T_a[sigma_2]) >= 0.0583. Route 11 extends zeta pole-free positivity to 2a <= ln 6, conditional to ln 11. Inside verified-height consequences (RES-T).

name: DH twin passes Route I window positivity
statement: Davenport-Heilbronn twin (same bridge as L(s,chi_5)): W_DH >= 0 proved for 2a <= 0.783, Arb-certified >= 0 to ln 11, Arb-certified negative at 2a = 3.44. Window positivity at support <= ln 3 does not separate the Euler product from the twin. Row P19; compare P5.

name: Toeplitz/Krein lattice-atom certificate lemma
statement: If nu = sum c_k t^k trig(x t) has all atoms at x >= X0 (Fourier support at +-x), then sigma_2 + nu >= 0 on R proves T_a[sigma_2] >= 0 for all 2a <= X0. Interval-verified at X0 = 0.90, 0.94, 0.96; certificate l1 norm grows x30-50 per 0.02 in 2a.

statement: w_1 has a negative dip on (6.945, 10.532), so sigma_2 is not a de Branges weight; two-window split bound crosses 0 at 2a = 0.6026 < ln 2. An indefinite Krein-Langer realisation relocates the gap to the same concentration inequality.

statement: lambda_1(T_a[sigma_2]) is real-analytic in a, about 8.34 at 2a=1.00, 0.577 at ln 3, 0 at 2a* about 1.1316 (measured 1.132 -> 1.100, N-dependent). One-prime reach a_2 = 0.565920 (2a_2 = ln 3 + 0.033).

statement: Open: an operator-theoretic bound showing the fraction of |ghat|^2 mass a function in L^2(-a,a) can place in the negative dip band [7.4, 10.8) is < 1 by enough to give lambda_1(a) > 0 uniformly on 0.96 < 2a < ln 3 (sub-gap IMP96769).

name: Semilocal Fourier transform F_S for S={inf,2}
statement: On L^2(X_S)^{Z_2^*} = L^2(R)_even: F_S eta = (1/2) sum_{n>=0} etahat(2^n .) - (1/2) etahat(./2) = I o (u_inf u_2), u_2 = (1-2^{s-1})/(1-2^{-s}) (Tate factor). Covariance F_S eta(2w) = F_S eta(w) - etahat(w) + etahat(w/2)/2.

statement: For all f: Tr(theta(f) P Phat_S P) = W_inf(f) + W_2(f) + D_S(f), delta_S(rho) = rho^{1/2} int K_S(rho xy) K_S(xy), K_S(t) = sum cos(2 pi 2^n t) - cos(pi t). Trace side positive: 2 theta' - m_2 + deltahat_S >= 0.0650. Controls (drop -cos(pi t), flip p=2 sign) go negative.

Binding direction: first p=2 resonance window (7.4, 10.8). Certified by other means (ARB-LEGE); no structural proof.

statement: For S containing 2 and 3 the remainder delta_S23 resonates on the dense set 2^a 3^b with log^2 spikes; remainder share 99.7-99.99997% (route 12). The compact-Toeplitz method has no foothold beyond one prime. Adjoining discrete P_3 instead gives Weil positivity W_{inf,2,3} > 0 again.

statement: lambda_S(0) = 0.9999731, lambda_S(1) = -0.9927022, 0.6202, -0.5609, then dyadic ladder +-2^{-n/2}/2; lambda_k ~ 1/(2 sqrt k); sum lambda^2 = inf, sum |lambda|^3 < inf. Theorem: no eigenvalue of modulus 1. Eigenfunctions lacunary/Zygmund with a log singularity at 0.

statement: eps_S = delta^out + corr. Cusp coefficients at rho = 2^k per log_2: delta_S 2^{k/2}/2, delta^in 2^{-k/2}/2, delta^out (2^{k/2} - 2^{-k/2})/2 (k=1: 0.7071/0.3536/0.3536); c_2 = 1/(2 sqrt2 ln 2). Near rho=1: eps_S(1+u) = u[(1/2) log_2(1/u) + 13.62].

statement: Minimum of the Weil form at a=(ln 3)/2 under successive constraints: 9.5e-4 (pole-free) -> 0.0334 (hhat(0)=0) -> 0.414 (hhat'(0)=0) -> 0.799 -> 0.814 (saturates). Negativity of the unconstrained minimiser sits in the dip band [7.4,10.8): -0.263 vs well -0.009.

statement: Even phi with phi = alpha cosh(u/2) + beta u sinh(u/2) on |u| < 2a, free outside; if w_1 + phihat >= m then W >= m ||h||^2 for all a' <= a. alpha=2, beta=0 is the Weil pole term; LP optima tend to it. Verified (double precision) 2a <= 0.96.

statement: Cauchy-Schwarz: Q(b) >= F(b)^2/S(b) >= 3 F(b)^2/b^3, F(b) = sum over a coprime to b of I(a,b). If F(b) >= kappa phi(b) b then Int(N) >= (36 kappa^2/pi^2) log N. Statement about the Nyman-Beurling Gram mean only. Row P15.

statement: If all zeros of H_0 satisfy |Im z| <= 2d (zeta zero-free for Re s > 1/2 + d) then Lambda <= 2 d^2 (de Bruijn); 7/8 gives 9/32. No converse: lowering Lambda does not produce a zero-free wall. Row F3.

statement: For dx/dt = F_Dyson + e with |e_{l+1} - e_l| <= eps' g_l at shared zero-table data: t_c in [ln(1+eps' H^2/4)/(2 eps'), H^2/(8 theta(eps'))], theta = 1 - (Psi(T,eps') + 2 eps' H^2)/8. No Gronwall, W_1 or pair correlation; modulus dW/deps' = 3H^4/64.

statement: The eps' premise is equivalent to K_l := 2 sum_y 1/(|x_l - y| |x_{l+1} - y|) <= eps'; the record gap g_l cancels identically, so no self-displacement control is needed. Global bound 2.85 against floor 22.92 at re-anchored plateaus.

statement: Forward de Bruijn-Newman flow preserves reality of zeros, so t_c(N) lies at negative time; the credit -t_c in Lambda <= -t_c + E(N) is not available. Upper bounds run through barrier realness above verified height. Row P31.

statement: Convolving Xi with a Gaussian of width sqrt(2 tau) gives exactly H_{-tau} (verified 1e-9 against the Polymath15 integral); repo units: t = -4 tau_repo. The large-tau drop in real-zero count is zeros leaving the line (content of Lambda >= 0).

statement: Even-multiplicity jets under dH/dt = -H_xx are scaled Hermite polynomials with all roots real forward in t (no lift-off); with de Bruijn's landing rate this is the architecture Lambda <= t_0 + Delta^2/2. Classical; gives no bound beyond verification height.

statement: Unique (0,1) root of R(rho) = 4 + 4 rho - 4/rho - 4/(rho+1) - 2[psi(1+2/rho) - psi(1+1/rho)]; the half-lattice majorant telescopes exactly, so R is the universal sharp bound on d_1^2 d rho/ds and every globally-minimal-pair configuration self-improves for rho < c_half.

All live ESY-closure routes share the Montgomery pair-correlation obstruction.

Unaudited with nontrivial content: 15.3, 16.4, 16.6, 18.1, 18.2 (Hilbert brackets, canonical-system closures, KYP realisations).

statement: A numerics-benchmark claim, independent of RH in both directions. Strong reading false: coefficient-dimension obstruction D >= 1.24e13 (imp-3932); window escapes pinned to the Odlyzko-Schonhage Nyquist floor; frozen-rung iff PT inertia theorem closes the verification channel. Row P30.

name: LEMMA PICK-ID / SGN-NP: Nevanlinna-Pick matrix = seam pencil
statement: The half-plane Nevanlinna-Pick matrix for data w_i = e^{-d nu_i} equals entrywise the seam pencil rho^2 G - D G D (Szego kernel at real nodes = Cauchy Gram); the signed shift constant Lambda is the squared minimal H^inf(C_+) interpolant norm exactly. Multiplier route terminal.

statement: Lambda_2 = w_1 w_2 + h^2/2 + (h/2) sqrt(h^2 + 4 w_1 w_2), h = (w_1 - w_2)(nu_1 + nu_2)/(nu_2 - nu_1). Coalescence law: Lambda_2 -> e^{-2x}(1 + 2x^2 + 2x sqrt(1+x^2)). Witness (1,2,ln 2): (13 + 3 sqrt17)/32.

statement: Co-centred signed sup R = 1/2 at every fixed depth; any signed bound R <= F(y_min) forces F >= 1/2. Exact rational witness N=2 refutes R <= e^{-y_min} for multi-rate signed families (factor 3/2). Certificates must be priced by count, weight, or modulus/phase.

statement: For at most N rates in [nu, R nu], depth d, x = nu d: sqrt(Lambda) <= e^{-x}[L_{N-1}(-2Rx) + 2 sum_{k<=N-2} L_k(-2Rx)]; no separation denominators. Two-sided at R=1: sqrt(Lambda_conf) = e^{-x}(2x)^{N-1}/(N-1)! (1+o(1)).

statement: Lambda(P,d) <= e^{-2sd} prod_{i,j} (p_i+p_j)/(p_i+p_j-2s) for any 0 < s < min P. All separation factors cancel: valid at coalescence, for arbitrary (off-lattice) rate sets, m-uniform on geometric lattices. Onset 15.48 (m=16, r=1.1).

Every-octave onsets 1.70/3.44/3.56 at m=2/6/16. Collared multi-block reduction is vacuous for N >= 3.

statement: 2x2 pencil in the (1,+-1) basis: det = (f_a^2 - |f_b|^2)/tanh^2(b/2); the pair identity sin^2(pi tau) cancels the tanh^2(b/2) normalisation. A_pen >= (16/a^2) W(rho) for r in (1, sqrt rho]; full (1,rho) uniformity impossible. Pointwise programme terminal.

statement: Alias grid = punctured lattice {n/p : n <= pD, p not dividing n}; width law mu(d) = d^{1/3}/c (beta = 1/3); octave weight (5/32)(pD)^{2/3} <= W(p,D) <= (28/3)(pD)^{2/3}. Bounded weight iff width exponent > 1. Exact identity x(D/2) = 1/Q.

name: Route P ledger at Platt-Trudgian height
statement: Certified 0.145276368594868 (3-band, two-point kernels, 255/369 floors); projection at targets 0.144962. Route H: RH to 4.80e12 gives 0.14497 at about 5.7e6 core-hours. Each value is a function of verified height; no zero information.

name: Explicit KKL threshold x0(t) ~ 4 pi exp(c/t), c about 5.3-5.8
statement: Route 20: covers only t >= 0.217 at X = 6e12. Route 50: beating route P at PT height needs c <= 3.912; the triangle method has c > 4.914.

name: One local RH window replaces contiguous verification
statement: Route 6 / Lemma B: a FLINT-isolated local window (21,665 zeros near 7.8e12, re-certified via Riemann-Siegel signs + Trudgian Thm 2.2) substitutes for about 1.7e12 units of contiguous verification inside the band-barrier framework.

name: Mollifier coefficients lambda_p are head-pinned
statement: The n = p terms freeze the prime coefficients of the mollifier; single-prime lanes are irreducible. Fixed-height mollifier lever capped near 0.174 (measured rho = 1.1151). Finite-lane length trades against t0 via D(sigma_1), sigma_1 = (1+y)/2 + (t/2) log N*.

name: Profile-sector reduction + excision budget (y-transfer)
statement: Termwise monotonicity in y is false for the 287-divisor 17-smooth mollifier; realisable active sets reduce to 20,546 profiles; L_N(y) >= L_N(y0) - B with B = sum cnt * supmass = 2.4957e-4 < margin 1.872e-3 (Arb, 256-bit). Gives Lambda <= 0.1758354 pending sign-off.

name: E_trunc at the PT anchor: kappa = 2/5, prefactor 2/kappa = 5
statement: At fixed sigma = 3/4, T_PT = 3e12 the locked exponent is kappa = 2/5; boundary term vanishes by N_off(T_PT) = 0; E_trunc_pt = 5.106e-5. Requirement curve A_max(B) = 3917/124.5/3.92/0.490 at B = 0/1/2/2.6; cap (2 beta - 1)^2/2 forces sigma <= 0.8162.

name: Crossing elasticities sum to zero by degree-0 homogeneity
statement: E_N = E_trunc + E_flow + E_coll, sigma = E_coll/E_N: scaling all three amplitudes leaves sigma and the crossing N_L invariant, so E_CC + E_ET + E_CF = 0 and E_CF/E_ET = E_flow/E_trunc.

name: Exact-saddle moment ratio R_n crosses 1 at n* = 215.2
statement: For moments of A(tau) = int Phi(s) Phi(s+tau) ds: R_n = |D_n|/|D_n^saddle| crosses 1 at n* = 215.231, well r_min = -5.845e-4 near n about 500, eps_n changes sign at n about 149. A is supported on [0, about 1.4].

name: Fifth-pair Gram degeneracy: spread is a few-ULP floor
statement: |lambda_9 - lambda_10|/lambda_9 = 0, 0, 1.97e-16, 1.38e-15, 1.96e-15, 1.96e-15 at N = 1200..2400 (dips at 2400); sigma_4 = lambda_9/lambda_1 climbs toward 1 (0.99876/0.99897/0.99914). Exact pairing of Gram eigenvalues; amplitude law of sigma_4 unmeasured.

name: Character-family average certified to 2a ~ 2 log q but Euler-blind
statement: Route 14: Weil positivity averaged over a character family is certified to support 2a about 2 log q; the identity holds with Lambda replaced by other functions, so it does not use the Euler product. Row P23.

name: Epstein zeta radii for 27 forms
statement: Route 15: upper bounds on off-line radii certified for 27 Epstein forms; lower ends hold in the even sector only (referee correction). A control family with functional equation and no Euler product for class number > 1.

name: Fifty-routes synthesis: four walls
statement: 43 done, 6 partial. 22 routes reduce to verified height, RH-equivalence, the pointwise wall, or flow-blindness; 18 produced new objects, none at RH level; only routes 1, 3, 5, 9 moved a certified Lambda value.

name: Pointwise wall: Dirichlet polynomial / Hilbert transform at a single height
statement: Recurring end point: the argument needs a pointwise (single-height) bound on a prime Dirichlet polynomial or its Hilbert transform, where only mean values are available. Matches MV-CAP and row S4 (one-sided head bound L3) and Q13.

name: Signed twin ladder = chi_4: G = L(2, chi_4)
statement: Sign flip on the ladder is the character chi_4: chi_4(2) = 0 deletes the p=2 rung, p = 3 mod 4 alternates, p = 1 mod 4 none; self-dual functional equation with epsilon = +1. Period obstruction: zeta kernel gives 5 zeta(2) - 8 (dim 2), Catalan kernel G - pi + 2 ln 2 + pi^2/12 (dim 5).

name: Gilbreath lock certificate
statement: Lemmas A/B/C: Gilbreath's conjecture is equivalent to some finite row of the absolute-difference triangle having its entire infinite tail in {0,2}; lockCertificate computes the provable depth. Open half isolated; no proof claimed.

name: Aristotle (Harmonic) autoformalisation
statement: CLI returns only kernel-verified Lean proofs. First result: expSum_hasDerivAt (finite exponential sum differentiable termwise), discharging hypothesis hA of DiniGate.summand_antitone. Toolchain v4.28 vs repo v4.22; basic Mathlib proofs transfer.

name: Requirement score R1-R4 for attack lanes
statement: R1 multiplicativity used essentially; R2 height-uniform, every window; R3 controls fail for a structural reason; R4 reaches the critical line. The 7/8 architecture scores 3 (lacks R4). Used with three referees on any lane scoring >= 3.
